query: First, it may maintain a close Bre1–Rad6 association during the H2Bub1 catalysis. Structural studies indicated that the E1 enzyme and the RING domain in the E3 enzymes compete for binding to the E2 enzyme (Cappadocia and Lima, 2018; Gundogdu and Walden, 2019; Stewart et al., 2016; Streich and Lima, 2014), resulting a 'ping-pong' motion of the E2 enzyme between the E1 enzyme and the RING domain during the catalysis. The Bre1 RBD–Rad6 interaction is not expected to interfere with the Rad6–E1 or Rad6–RING interactions (Figure 1—figure supplement 4A, B).
